display_long_description:
Primal Monke is a multiplayer VR experience where you step into the role of a primal monke and explore a fast-paced world built for movement, fun, and chaos with friends. Swing, climb, and traverse different environments while playing alongside other players in real time.

The game features multiple modes, including intense horror experiences that test your awareness and teamwork, as well as fun casual gameplay areas where you can just hang out, move around, and enjoy the world. Whether you’re trying to survive, explore, or just mess around with friends, there’s always something to do.

You can also visit the in-game shop to customize your monke with cosmetics and stand out from other players. More content and game modes are planned for future updates, expanding the world and adding even more ways to play.

Grab your friends, jump in, and experience the world of Primal Monke—where movement, survival, and fun all come together in VR.
